status.current_task: 个人版/企业单租户版完成 - 生产就绪

context.description: Rust implementation of MemoryOS with unified vector storage architecture. All memory tiers (short-term, mid-term, long-term) now use vector databases (Qdrant/Chroma/Pinecone) for persistent storage. Redis/NATS repositioned as coordination layer. Complete FAQ system, 6 performance optimization modules, IP defense system. Production ready with comprehensive documentation. This is the Personal/Enterprise Single-Tenant Edition.

format_constraints.file_naming: snake_case (strictly functional naming, no version numbers like _v1, _new)
format_constraints.architecture: Hexagonal Architecture (Core -> Ports -> Adapters). Monolithic Binary with Feature Flags.

issues_log.description: Documentation mentioned SQLite for LTM storage but it was never implemented.
